description: Liquid AI's LFM2.5-Audio, loaded from the llama.cpp-format GGUF components Liquid publishes. ASR: a FastConformer encoder feeds an LFM2 hybrid short-conv/attention backbone. TTS: the backbone generates audio frames through a depthformer, and an LFM2 detokenizer and ISTFT turn them into 24 kHz audio. S2S: a spoken question goes in as for ASR, and the reply comes out as interleaved text and audio.

request.name: language
request.description: Must match the checkpoint's language (en or ja) when given; each published checkpoint transcribes and speaks one language.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: ASR: transcript tokens per audio chunk, 512 by default. TTS: audio frames (80 ms each) per text chunk, 512 by default. S2S: text tokens and audio frames of the reply together, 1024 by default. A transcript, a text chunk's speech or a reply that reaches it is cut off there, with a warning on stderr.

request.name: audio_chunk_mode
request.description: Audio chunking mode. auto transcribes input up to audio_chunk_seconds whole and splits longer input at pauses found by the bundled VAD (fixed chunks when the VAD model is absent); vad always splits at pauses and skips silence; fixed cuts every audio_chunk_seconds; none transcribes the whole input at once.

request.name: audio_chunk_seconds
request.description: Longest chunk in seconds, at least 1. With fixed chunks, a final piece shorter than 1 second joins the previous chunk.

request.name: temperature
request.description: TTS and S2S: audio code sampling temperature, 0.8 by default for TTS and 1.0 for S2S; 0 picks the most likely code.

request.name: top_k
request.description: TTS and S2S: sample audio codes from the k most likely, 64 by default for TTS and 4 for S2S; 0 keeps all, 1 is greedy.

request.name: text_temperature
request.description: S2S: text token sampling temperature; 0, the default, picks the most likely token, as liquid-audio's README and demo do.

request.name: text_top_k
request.description: S2S: with a text_temperature above 0, sample text tokens from the k most likely; 0, the default, keeps all, and 1 is greedy.

request.name: seed
request.description: TTS and S2S: sampling seed; omitted requests choose a random seed. TTS text chunk i uses seed + i. S2S text sampling draws from a stream of its own, so with the same seed a reply follows the greedy-text reply until a text token differs.

request.name: text_chunk_mode
request.description: TTS: long-form text chunking mode; japanese for the Japanese checkpoint and default otherwise when omitted.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: TTS: maximum Unicode codepoints per text chunk, each spoken as its own turn.

request.name: stream_frames_per_event
request.description: TTS and S2S streaming: audio frames (80 ms each) per event; each event's audio is final. ASR runs offline only.

session.name: model_gguf
session.description: Backbone GGUF, relative to the model directory. Defaults to the directory's only backbone GGUF.

session.name: mmproj_gguf
session.description: Audio encoder (mmproj) GGUF, relative to the model directory. Defaults to mmproj-<backbone GGUF name>, or else the directory's only mmproj GGUF.

session.name: vocoder_gguf
session.description: TTS: vocoder GGUF (depthformer), relative to the model directory. Defaults to vocoder-<backbone GGUF name>, or else the directory's only vocoder GGUF.

session.name: detokenizer_gguf
session.description: TTS: audio detokenizer GGUF, relative to the model directory. Defaults to tokenizer-<backbone GGUF name>, or else the directory's only tokenizer GGUF.

session.name: vad_model_path
session.description: Path to the Silero VAD model directory used by automatic audio chunking.

session.name: max_pass_seconds
session.description: Most audio, in seconds, the encoder takes in one pass: an ASR chunk (the whole input with audio_chunk_mode=none) or the S2S question. Longer audio is rejected before it is encoded.

ui.summary: LFM2.5-Audio transcription, speech and spoken chat (English and Japanese checkpoints) from Liquid's published GGUFs.
